caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, brown-toned object resembling a punched leather or metal sheet, set against a cream-colored background. The object measures approximately 8 1/2 inches in width and 12 1/4 inches in height, with these dimensions indicated by black lines and handwriting on the background. The surface of the object features an intricate symmetrical pattern made up of small, regularly spaced white dots forming circles, spirals, and linear designs. There appear to be two large central spiral motifs with smaller circular arrangements and scrollwork filling the rest of the space. The edges of the rectangle are bordered with a row of dots, and the overall composition is centered on the page. The drawing is signed "Geoffrey Holt" in the bottom right corner of the background.
title: Pierced Metal Screen from Confessional
